chunk_map.heading: Exercise: Take it to the team (H1 + lede)
Phase 1: Sketch the way of working
Phase 4: Find the bottleneck, draft both plans
Phase 6: Put Monday on the board and in the team folder

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L17: "Open `team/five-users.md` at the call you made." closest to violating: names a session artifact (carve-out) and the file, call defined by five-users in the module include order. L41 "the frame" resolves to the Way of working frame named at L17; L79 "the old way" resolves to L7/L19. Harm (unresolvable referent on a projected slide) absent.

L87: "On Day 1 it was the three of you deciding what your agents could read." names the day and the artifact (`team/what-goes-in.md`), not 'the opening lecture' by position. grep 'the (opening|previous|last) (lecture|exercise)' -> none.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L17 'the call you made' -> apt101-five-users phase 4; L19/L9 'draft made on Day 2' -> apt101-make-your-piece produces team/<team lead>/way-of-working.md; L25 agent instructions from `agents/` -> apt101-send-it-off; L87 -> apt101-what-goes-in. All exist in learn-faster-than-the-market.md include order / exercises dir.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L27-L29: expectation post-it written before the run ('writes one sentence on a post-it: what you expect it to return'), outcome only narrated at L33 after the run; setup sentences are verbed ('Then run the file as written, in your own folder'), no screen-only pronoun. Closest: L27 'The run never sees the post-it' stays inside (states a fact, not a reveal).
Every chunk carries instructions plus a self-carrying claim; smallest, chunk 1 L15-19, holds two paragraphs and a concrete post-it move (L17).

Closest: chunk 6 'Put Monday on the board and in the team folder' L81: body covers plans into the team folder (L85-89, prompt team-monday) and the board read (L91); both halves of the header are present. Chunk 3 'Interview for the job' matches L39-L52.

grep '^Not |\. Not ' -> 0; no superlative ('most useful|powerful' -> 0); no number+retraction. Closest: L65 'who reads what the agents produce, who corrects them, who teaches the next person?' is a triplet of three distinct concrete roles, each answerable alone, not an empty-leg verb triplet.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep '\b(beat|mood|firing|compendium|forcing function|surface)\b' -> 0 in body. Closest: 'frame' (L9, L17) is Miro/JTBD ordinary usage the room holds; 'the call' L17 is ordinary language for the decision.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep '\*\*[^*]+\*\*' body -> 10 hits, all <=5-word sub-spans, none a whole lead sentence: L11, L25 role handle; L43-46 four shapes (checklist item names, verbatim per check_student_facing §34); L64-65 two role labels in the split reading. Closest: chunk 4 L64-65 carries two bold labels, which act as find-your-line handles for two readers, consistent with the file's role bolding at L11/L25; harm (emphasis dilution on a narrative slide) not present.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L39 of learn-faster-than-the-market.md: '[Exercise: Take it to the team](exercises/apt101-take-it-to-the-team.md)' standalone include line; exercise wrapper gives phase--exercise. check-slide-size --file reports slides: 6.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/exercises/apt101-take-it-to-the-team.md -> 'OK — 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent.' exit 0 (Phase 1-6 consecutive; L11 'all but Phase 2' resolves).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/exercises/apt101-take-it-to-the-team.md -> 'OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.' exit 0; grep '\b(below|above)\b' -> 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no in-body links (grep '](' on body -> 0; check-slide-deixis --links lists none)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/exercises/apt101-take-it-to-the-team.md -> 'slides: 6 ... oversized: 0 ... every slide is within limits' exit 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Headings L13,21,35,54,69,81 are all 'Phase N: <imperative/label>' (exercise grammar); no declarative heading required or present. Closest: 'Phase 5: Test the switch' is an imperative, correct for an exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L91 'It is a proposal. The team that lives with it decides.' reads as a kicker but adds a priority (the trio must not assert; unnamed parts stay empty) and does not restate the header 'Put Monday on the board and in the team folder'; L79 'The old way stayed because it did the job well enough.' gives the reason for the pushback move; L67 'They are Monday's questions.' names what to do with the gaps.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: git log -p over the file's last 8 commits shows no changed '## ' line (grep '^[-+]## ' -> none); no provenance note of the '(from <old-file>, header his)' shape in the maintainer block.

notes: Rulebook built via derive-class-brief (17 rules, prefill parked 0). Body 6 slides per check-slide-size (chunk 0 is the lede). Prompt blocks are {{prompt:}} markers, not expanded (rows judged against the raw body; registry prompt bodies are check_prompts lane).
